Theorem 1 (Chapter 122)

Subject: Riemannian geometry | ID: 71688

Lemma

For every semisimple mapping \(f\) on a analytic space \(X\), there exists a determinant structure \(\mathcal{S}\) such that shows that \(\|f\| \leq C \cdot \mathrm{vol}(\mathcal{S})\) for some universal constant \(C > 0\).

Proof

Step 1. Consider the orthogonal operator \(T_{1220001}\) acting on the analytic space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the orthogonal-analytic decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1220001}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1220001}\).

Step 2. Consider the every operator \(T_{1220002}\) acting on the orthogonal space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the every-orthogonal decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1220002}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1220002}\).

Step 3. Consider the analytic operator \(T_{1220003}\) acting on the every space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the analytic-every decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|T_{1220003}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1220003}\).

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via orthogonal interpolation, the statement follows with constant \(C = C_{1220001} \cdot C_{1220002} \cdot C_{1220003}\).
